reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was 'Every batch lab-tested' with the QR code, and then that it says up front that 200 mg is two capsules, which is what usually annoys me. I've tried three magnesium brands this year, so I'd order one box to try, but only one.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal. A lab report you scan yourself isn't the same as a seal I already trust, and I don't know who this brand is yet.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal, or a batch report I can open that shows a real result for my box, plus a few verified reviews.
